title: The gate runs selfdoc's tools-map test for a change to any _tools Python file
goal: testmap.py maps a change to any _tools/*.py file to test_selfdoc's TestSelfdocToolsMap, and selfdoc.map_tools and check_map number a source's lines by LF alone, so a file holding a literal U+2028, U+2029 or U+0085 neither shifts the map nor reaches main unchecked. Failure it answers: in SP-vpk5nrrc the BG-axnyomq3 test put a literal U+2028 into test_kb_mcp.py, the gate ran 7 of 32 test files without test_selfdoc, and the map test failed on main until BG-nzzmq6o2.
